description: Home Affairs SkillSelect EOI pool snapshot (end of month): how many expressions of interest are waiting for subclass 189, 190 or 491 (state nominated), by points score and, for 190/491, by state. Without occupation: the whole stream plus the ANZSCO groups with the largest pools. With occupation: that occupation's pool, by points and state, with the last 12 months' trend. Pass points to see how many EOIs sit above and at that score.

locale.description: Language of names/descriptions in the result: zh-CN (default, Simplified Chinese plus English names), en-US, zh-TW. Also selects the language prefix of returned oneuedu.com URLs.

month.description: Snapshot month YYYY-MM (end-of-month "as at" data). Default: latest.

occupation.description: Internal occupationCode from search_occupations, or occupation URL/slug. anzsco is a shared classification code, not a unique identity. Exact internal code matches take precedence; search to select a candidate only if no exact match exists.

points.description: Points score to position in the pool (EOIs with higher and equal points).

name: get_eoi_backlog
title: Get SkillSelect EOI backlog
